title: 0210 - RHEnd Part B20 appended: the A1 assembly face is restated as IN-TREE (0209), the endpoint's external input surface is named, and the live board re-sweep (37/37 parsed, as_of 2026-10-28) confirms NO new record and NO B6 fire - board best on the density side is still the in-tree face 0.8739461. New named reference theorem a1GridClauseNamed (the 0209 grid clause in the record). No RH claim
body: 0210 closes the 0209 loop at the endpoint object: Part B20 is appended (append-only, after B19.5) to formal/RhAttack/RHEnd.lean. (1) RESTATEMENT: not a tracker event - the density-side board best is still [Z78DensityRefined] 0.8739461 (the record the B19 endpoint is built on), so B6 does NOT fire; what moved is the A1 lane: the W2Beyond3 A1 assembly's GRID-RESTRICTED clause (its own signature) is closed data-free at the certified 3e10 frontier (0209), and with the 0206-0208 premise-free pins the A1 lane's external surface is exactly two peer-reviewed theorems (Trudgian 2012 A1G-5; the RvM identity with explicit residual, Titchmarsh 9.7-type) + e < 4. The STRONGER absolute clause (all zeros, unbounded) remains NAMED/OPEN (0207 face_unbounded) and is documented as NOT what the assembly consumes. The B19 endpoint's external input (Z78DensityRefined) and terminal face hOffC on 0 < d0 <= 3739461/10000000 are unchanged. (2) NAMED REFERENCE: new theorem RHEnd.a1GridClauseNamed - the 0209 grid clause (uniform K = 33206/5000 = 6.6412 over the zero grid, from exactly the two CITED theorems + e < 4) stated in the endpoint record so the external surface is NAMED in-tree. (3) BOARD RE-SWEEP LESSON: the live catalogue (https://gtimg.github.io/QuasiRiemannTracker/catalogue.json) stores theta as {'numerator': '1', 'denominator': '1'} with STRING numerals - a float/numeric parse silently drops all records; int() the string fields. On that scan: 37/37 records, as_of 2026-10-28, MIN (not max - lower theta is better for this exceptional-density quantity) = 0.8739461 = in-tree face; all 36 other records are weaker/older (the 'classical-euler-product' 1.0 and the 0.87879 single-prime record are historical baselines, not merged improvements). (4) Pinned-API lesson: RHEnd.lean lives in namespace RHEnd (flat, not under a RhAttack wrapper - these modules use FLAT namespaces: W2Beyond0, W2B3, A1G, RHEnd ...); cross-module names resolve only if the declaring module is imported (W2T is declared in W2Telescope.lean, not W2Beyond0!), and the correct qualification is the flat name (W2T.DN, A1G.G_explicit), NOT Rhattack-prefixed (RhAttack.W2T fails - the package root is not a namespace). Finset.mem_range in this pin does not take a bare .mpr - restate goals as 'forall j <= M' (the form a1_grid_clause_exhibit uses) instead of 'forall j in range (M+1)'. Builds: RHEnd 8760 green (one pre-existing whitespace lint at the file's final 'end RHEnd' line, present at git HEAD - not new); full package 17454 green. No RH claim.
